acc_q_004.blind_ambiguities: 'Same amount' can be read strictly. If so, some partial payments of invoices that do exist would also count as unmatched: Marina Fuel 13,200.00 on 22/09 (invoice INV-2026-1182 is 26,400.00, and nothing in the file supports splitting it); SeaGlass 7,830.00 on 15/09 (invoice less credit note = 7,840.00, so 10.00 short); and arguably the two Mediterra instalments of 5,790.00 (the invoice does allow two equal instalments). I treated these as matched to their referenced invoices. Separately, the LME-26-0611 payment of 5,480.00 matches on payee name and amount, but the notice shows it went to IBAN LT36 3250 0000 1234 5678 (UAPELT22XXX). That is not the IBAN in the supplier master file (IT19 K061 7522 7000 0000 4417 302); it is the account given in the bank-change e-mail from the domain lme-sanremo-it.example.
acc_q_004.notes: Blind reviewer 2 noted that 'same amount' read strictly would also leave partial and short payments unmatched. Rule rewritten: matched = label or execution notice cites a document of the same payee, whatever the amount. Reference unchanged (2 debits, EUR 5,730.00), matching the blind answer.
